item.title: Widén Elementary no longer under Secure after police activity in area
item.description: An Austin ISD elementary school is back to normal operations after police activity in the area.According to a letter to the Widén Elementary community, the campus was under a Secure for almost half an hour early Wednesday morning. The Secure was due to police activity in the area.In Austin ISD, a Secure means that all students and staff were kept inside the building while normal operations continued inside. item.title: SE Austin resident lives next to creek full of dumped furniture, says city won't clean it up
item.description: A Southeast Austin resident is living by a creek that's full of dumped furniture. She says she's been calling the city for months to clean it up, but more stuff keeps piling up. Esther Govea has lived on Teri Road for 30 years. She says in the past, if people threw stuff in the creek, and she called the city, crews would come clean it. item.title: San Marcos leaders reject plans to build controversial data center
